Hi Sam / Olivia —

Great to meet you both on the discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed next step: we'd like to run a 30-minute product intro tailored to the three stakeholder groups you mentioned (Platform, Security, Product). The goal for the session is to show a short end-to-end flow, surface expected latency/cost for a few typical queries, and agree on success criteria for a pilot.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all PT):
- Option A: Wed Jun 18, 10:00–10:30 AM PT — best for Platform + one product owner
- Option B: Thu Jun 19, 2:00–2:30 PM PT — Security-friendly (later in day)
- Option C: Mon Jun 23, 9:00–9:30 AM PT — good if your exec sponsor prefers mornings

Suggested attendee pairing (we'll bring product + solutions engineering):
- Platform: Data Platform / Infrastructure engineer (we'll demo KV cache + batching)
- Security: Security/compliance owner (we'll walk through VPC/Private options and audit logs)
- Product: PM or owner for the pilot success criteria discussion

Attachments: redwood-30m-outline.pdf (one-pager agenda). I also included a Calendly link below if you prefer to pick a time directly.

Next steps: please reply with the option that maps to your attendees, or pick a slot via https://calendly.com/redwood/lauren-30m — happy to repeat the demo for multiple stakeholder groups if that makes sense.

Thanks,
Lauren
